exposure: severe fear of childbirth postpartum (PP FOC)
child in need of neonatal care
cohort: 76 women aged ≥ 18 years who had undergone complicated childbirth
finding: Women with severe postpartum fear of childbirth reported significantly higher levels of PTSS, and significantly lower QoL in five dimensions: physical role functioning, emotional role functioning, energy/fatigue, emotional well-being, and social functioning.
